Create a set of 6 Instagram Story-style static posts for a premium med spa growth brand called The Luxora Collective.
Brand Style & Aesthetic:
Color palette: deep maroon/burgundy, dark green, black, cream, soft neutrals
Clean, elevated, luxury feel (similar to high-end wellness or beauty brands)
Minimalist but bold
Use modern serif + clean sans-serif font pairing (elegant, feminine, high-end)
High contrast text that is easy to read on mobile
Subtle textures or gradients, no clutter
Designed specifically for Instagram Story (9:16 vertical)
Audience: Med spa owners doing $500K–$2M who feel stuck, overwhelmed, or like something is “off” in their business
Core Messaging Themes:
It’s not a lead problem, it’s a systems problem
Revenue leaks between appointments
Owners didn’t start their business to manage chaos
Fix what happens between lead → booking → consult → membership
Focus on LTV, not just new clients
Calm, clarity, control, scalability
Create 6 different slides with bold, emotionally resonant copy:
Slide 1: “This isn’t how running your med spa was supposed to feel”
Slide 2: “You don’t need more leads
You need to fix what’s happening in between”
Slide 3: “200 leads → 50 book → 30 show → 12 start → 2 stay
That’s where your money is going”
Slide 4: “You didn’t start this to chase numbers and manage chaos
You started it for transformation”
Slide 5: “Most med spas don’t have a marketing problem
They have a conversion problem”
Slide 6 (CTA slide): “Find your revenue leaks
The Luxora Collective”
(Optional small subtext: “Growth partners for med spa owners ready to scale”)
Design Notes:
Each slide should feel cohesive as a set
Use strong hierarchy (big headline, minimal supporting text)
Some slides can include subtle icons or abstract shapes (no stock photos)
Leave safe margins for Instagram UI (top/bottom spacing)
Make it feel premium, not salesy
